description: Reverse-ETL message activation: send a personalized push notification via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) to each row of an upstream DataFrame (`firebase_admin.messaging.send(...)` against the row's device token). Sends REAL push notifications the moment this asset materializes -- no upload-for-later-matching indirection.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one FCM push send, personalized via message_template/title_template.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (messages_sent / messages_failed / rows_skipped_no_recipient). No downstream data -- the send side effect is a real push notification on the recipient's device.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

recipient_column.label: Recipient Column
recipient_column.description: Upstream column holding the target FCM device registration token.

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: Push notification body template. Supports {column_name} substitution from other upstream row columns.

title_template.label: Title Template
title_template.description: Push notification title template (same {column_name} substitution). Optional.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (blast-radius safety cap, not a rate limit).

name: Firebase FCM Send
